description: This tool returns every published figure for one program. A program is one credential in one field at one school. The results include median earnings 1, 4, 5 and 7 years after finishing with the cohort and the count, the national figure for the field, the comparison with the Department's medians for high-school graduates, federal loan debt and awards.

cip4.description: The four-digit field code, as in the page address.

credential.description: Credential level from 1 to 8: 1 undergraduate certificate, 2 associate's, 3 bachelor's, 4 post-baccalaureate certificate, 5 master's, 6 doctoral, 7 first professional, 8 graduate certificate.

opeid6.description: The school's six-digit federal ID (OPEID6), as in the page address.

name: get_program
title: Get one program
